metadata.question: Was the soil in Washington more moist on November 22, 2021 than November 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need soil moisture data for Washington state - Two specific dates: November 22, 2021 and November 15, 2021 - Will use NASA SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) data which provides soil moisture at ~10km resolution - Collection: "NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture" 2. Masking strategy: - SMAP data has quality flags - should mask out poor quality data - The question is about soil moisture values, not clouds - Will use the 'ssm' (surface soil moisture) band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid soil moisture ranges from 0 to ~0.6 (volumetric water content) - If no images exist for either date → C1 - If images exist but all pixels masked/invalid → C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN or unrealistic values → C3 - Compare mean soil moisture: Nov 22 > Nov 15 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Washington state geometry const washington = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Washington')) .geometry(); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2021-11-15'; const date2 = '2021-11-22'; // 3. Load SMAP soil moisture data const smap = ee.ImageCollection('NASA_USDA/HSL/SMAP10KM_soil_moisture'); // Get images for both dates (SMAP updates every ~3 days, so use 3-day window) const img1 = smap .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(3, 'day')) .filterBounds(washington) .select('ssm') .mean(); const img2 = smap .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(3, 'day')) .filterBounds(washington) .select('ssm') .mean(); // Check if collections have data const col1 = smap.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(3, 'day')).filterBounds(washington); const col2 = smap.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(3, 'day')).filterBounds(washington); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 15 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Nov 22 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('No data for one or both dates.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate mean soil moisture and pixel counts const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: washington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: washington, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const moisture1 = stats1.ssm_mean; const count1 = stats1.ssm_count; const moisture2 = stats2.ssm_mean; const count2 = stats2.ssm_count; console.log(`Nov 15: Moisture=${moisture1?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Nov 22: Moisture=${moisture2?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 5. Validation and answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (moisture1 == null || moisture2 == null || isNaN(moisture1) || isNaN(moisture2)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (moisture1 < 0 || moisture1 > 1 || moisture2 < 0 || moisture2 > 1) { console.log('Invalid soil moisture range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare moisture levels if (moisture2 > moisture1) { console.log('Nov 22 was more moist than Nov 15.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Nov 22 was not more moist than Nov 15.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
